'''Alden Kraimer''' was the [[Chief of Security/Legends|Security Chief]] for [[Elrood Starport Command]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]]. Kraimer confirmed that [[Earnst Kamiel]], one of the leaders of the [[Justice Action Network]], had been apprehended attempting to enter [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]] on false identity papers.
